
diplomacy_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { 
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = true_magick_temp_mods
                target = var:diplomacy_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = diplomacy_true_magick 
        }
    }
}

diplomacy_true_magick_modifier_decrease = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:diplomacy_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_trigger = yes
            decrease_diplomacy_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:diplomacy_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

diplomacy_true_magick_modifier_decrease_5 = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:diplomacy_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_5_trigger = yes
            decrease_diplomacy_true_magic_5_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:diplomacy_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 5 }
            }
        }
    }
}

diplomacy_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_diplomacy_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = diplomacy_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = diplomacy_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:diplomacy_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

diplomacy_true_magick_modifier_increase = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {

                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title

            }
        }
    }

dread_loss_mult_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_dread_loss_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = dread_loss_mult_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = dread_loss_mult_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:dread_loss_mult_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

dynasty_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_dynasty_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = dynasty_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = dynasty_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:dynasty_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

estonian_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_estonian_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = estonian_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = estonian_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:estonian_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:sao_opinion_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_trigger = yes
            decrease_sao_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:sao_opinion_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

sao_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_sao_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = sao_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = sao_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:sao_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }

nubian_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_nubian_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = nubian_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = nubian_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:nubian_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_volhynian_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = volhynian_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = volhynian_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:volhynian_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

volhynian_opinion_true_magick_modifier_increase = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:volhynian_opinion_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_trigger = yes
            increase_volhynian_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:volhynian_opinion_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }

        }
    }
}

        }
    }
}

asturleonese_opinion_true_magick_modifier_decrease = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:asturleonese_opinion_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_trigger = yes
            decrease_asturleonese_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:asturleonese_opinion_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

asturleonese_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_asturleonese_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = asturleonese_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = asturleonese_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:asturleonese_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

gujarati_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_gujarati_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = gujarati_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = gujarati_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:gujarati_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_sinhala_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = sinhala_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = sinhala_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:sinhala_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

sinhala_opinion_true_magick_modifier_increase = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:sinhala_opinion_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_trigger = yes
            increase_sinhala_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:sinhala_opinion_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

nepali_opinion_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { 
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = true_magick_temp_mods
                target = var:nepali_opinion_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = nepali_opinion_true_magick 
        }
    }
}

        give_italian_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }

        scope:target = {
            if = {

                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }

                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }

hungarian_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_hungarian_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = hungarian_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = hungarian_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:hungarian_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

songhai_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_songhai_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = songhai_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = songhai_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:songhai_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

                }

                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title

            }
        }
    }

    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:zhangzhung_opinion_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_trigger = yes
            increase_zhangzhung_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:zhangzhung_opinion_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

sumpa_opinion_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { 
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = true_magick_temp_mods
                target = var:sumpa_opinion_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = sumpa_opinion_true_magick 
        }
    }
}

    scope = character

        }
    }

                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 1 }

        }

sumpa_opinion_true_magick_modifier_decrease_5 = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }

        }

}

sumpa_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_sumpa_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = sumpa_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = sumpa_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:sumpa_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:chuvash_opinion_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_5_trigger = yes
            increase_chuvash_opinion_true_magic_5_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:chuvash_opinion_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 5 }
            }
        }
    }
}

shatuo_opinion_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { 
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = true_magick_temp_mods
                target = var:shatuo_opinion_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = shatuo_opinion_true_magick 
        }
    }
}

shatuo_opinion_true_magick_modifier_decrease = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:shatuo_opinion_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_trigger = yes
            decrease_shatuo_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:shatuo_opinion_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

shatuo_opinion_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_shatuo_opinion_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = shatuo_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = shatuo_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:shatuo_opinion_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    }

        scope:target = {
            if = {

                    NOT = { has_variable = meshchera_opinion_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = meshchera_opinion_true_magick value = scope:store_title }

                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }

max_elope_schemes_add_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_max_elope_schemes_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = max_elope_schemes_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = max_elope_schemes_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:max_elope_schemes_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

embrace_scheme_power_add_true_magick_modifier_decrease = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:embrace_scheme_power_add_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_trigger = yes
            decrease_embrace_scheme_power_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:embrace_scheme_power_add_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

embrace_scheme_power_add_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_embrace_scheme_power_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = embrace_scheme_power_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = embrace_scheme_power_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:embrace_scheme_power_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:herdify_mortal_scheme_resistance_mult_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_trigger = yes
            increase_herdify_mortal_scheme_resistance_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:herdify_mortal_scheme_resistance_mult_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { 
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = true_magick_temp_mods
                target = var:max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick 
        }
    }
}

max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick_modifier_decrease = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_trigger = yes
            decrease_max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:max_herdify_vampire_schemes_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }

            }
        }
    }

    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_ordinationgantenbein_scheme_power_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {

                    NOT = { has_variable = ordinationgantenbein_scheme_power_mult_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = ordinationgantenbein_scheme_power_mult_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:ordinationgantenbein_scheme_power_mult_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:seduce_scheme_resistance_mult_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_5_trigger = yes
            increase_seduce_scheme_resistance_mult_true_magic_5_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:seduce_scheme_resistance_mult_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 5 }
            }
        }
    }
}

max_sway_schemes_add_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }

                target = var:max_sway_schemes_add_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = max_sway_schemes_add_true_magick

    }

max_sway_schemes_add_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_max_sway_schemes_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = max_sway_schemes_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = max_sway_schemes_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:max_sway_schemes_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_valid = {
        give_witchhunters_siege_value_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = witchhunters_siege_value_mult_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = witchhunters_siege_value_mult_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:witchhunters_siege_value_mult_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

ghouls_damage_add_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_ghouls_damage_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = ghouls_damage_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = ghouls_damage_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:ghouls_damage_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

                }

            }
        }
    }

    is_valid = {
        give_szlachta_damage_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = szlachta_damage_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = szlachta_damage_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:szlachta_damage_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

szlachta_damage_add_true_magick_modifier_increase = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:szlachta_damage_add_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_trigger = yes
            increase_szlachta_damage_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:szlachta_damage_add_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:skirmishers_damage_add_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_5_trigger = yes
            increase_skirmishers_damage_add_true_magic_5_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:skirmishers_damage_add_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 5 }
            }
        }
    }
}

skirmishers_damage_mult_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { 
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = true_magick_temp_mods
                target = var:skirmishers_damage_mult_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = skirmishers_damage_mult_true_magick 
        }
    }
}

skirmishers_damage_mult_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_skirmishers_damage_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = skirmishers_damage_mult_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = skirmishers_damage_mult_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:skirmishers_damage_mult_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:light_cavalry_damage_mult_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_5_trigger = yes
            decrease_light_cavalry_damage_mult_true_magic_5_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:light_cavalry_damage_mult_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 5 }
            }
        }
    }
}

light_cavalry_damage_mult_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_light_cavalry_damage_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = light_cavalry_damage_mult_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = light_cavalry_damage_mult_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:light_cavalry_damage_mult_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

bowmen_max_size_add_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_bowmen_max_size_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = bowmen_max_size_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = bowmen_max_size_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:bowmen_max_size_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

        give_shades_pursuit_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = shades_pursuit_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = shades_pursuit_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:shades_pursuit_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

wolves_damage_mult_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_wolves_damage_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = wolves_damage_mult_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = wolves_damage_mult_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:wolves_damage_mult_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_scorpions_damage_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = scorpions_damage_mult_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = scorpions_damage_mult_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:scorpions_damage_mult_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

scorpions_damage_mult_true_magick_modifier_increase = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:scorpions_damage_mult_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_trigger = yes
            increase_scorpions_damage_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:scorpions_damage_mult_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

scorpions_toughness_add_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { 
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = true_magick_temp_mods
                target = var:scorpions_toughness_add_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = scorpions_toughness_add_true_magick 
        }
    }
}

pikemen_max_size_add_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_pikemen_max_size_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = pikemen_max_size_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = pikemen_max_size_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:pikemen_max_size_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_5_trigger = yes
            decrease_siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magic_5_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 5 }
            }
        }
    }
}

siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magick_modifier_increase = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_increase_trigger = yes
            increase_siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:siege_weapon_max_size_add_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

siege_weapon_max_size_mult_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { 
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = true_magick_temp_mods
                target = var:siege_weapon_max_size_mult_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = siege_weapon_max_size_mult_true_magick 
        }
    }
}

    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_trigger = yes
            decrease_no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magick_modifier_decrease_5 = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_5_trigger = yes
            decrease_no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magic_5_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 5 }
            }
        }
    }
}

no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:no_water_crossing_penalty_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

raid_speed_true_magick_modifier_remove = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { 
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = true_magick_temp_mods
                target = var:raid_speed_true_magick
            }
            remove_variable = raid_speed_true_magick 
        }
    }
}

winter_advantage_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_winter_advantage_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = winter_advantage_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = winter_advantage_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:winter_advantage_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {
            var:plains_attrition_mult_true_magick = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = modifier
            }
        }
        OR = {
            basic_decrease_trigger = yes
            decrease_plains_attrition_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
        }
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            var:plains_attrition_mult_true_magick = {
                change_variable = { name = counter subtract = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

plains_attrition_mult_true_magick_modifier_decrease_5 = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        scope:target = {

plains_attrition_mult_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_plains_attrition_mult_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = plains_attrition_mult_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = plains_attrition_mult_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:plains_attrition_mult_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

oasis_advantage_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_oasis_advantage_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = oasis_advantage_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = oasis_advantage_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:oasis_advantage_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

wetlands_cancel_negative_supply_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_wetlands_cancel_negative_supply_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = wetlands_cancel_negative_supply_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = wetlands_cancel_negative_supply_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:wetlands_cancel_negative_supply_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

siege_phase_time_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_siege_phase_time_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = siege_phase_time_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = siege_phase_time_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:siege_phase_time_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_valid = {
        give_vassal_levy_contribution_add_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = vassal_levy_contribution_add_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = vassal_levy_contribution_add_true_magick value = scope:store_title }

                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:vassal_levy_contribution_add_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}

build_piety_cost_true_magick_modifier_add = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { target }
    
    is_valid = {
        give_build_piety_cost_true_magic_trigger = yes
    }
    
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = build_piety_cost_true_magick }
                }
                create_store_title = { NAME = DEFAULT_SPELL_NAME }
                set_variable = { name = build_piety_cost_true_magick value = scope:store_title }
                scope:store_title = {
                    set_variable = { name = type value = flag:build_piety_cost_true_magick }
                    set_variable = { name = counter value = 0 }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = true_magick_temp_mods
                    target = scope:store_title
                }
                
            }
        }
    }
}
